verdict: Sway reaches the pins along four paths. With the rim holding (an O-ring force the canon lacks), two are a fraction of the preload: the stack's inertia (per gram, × a pair factor the layout sets) and a mass-independent centre-pad term in the stem's surface strain; without it, the pins slide (55's regime). The input describes one January day of one smaller tree.
